underground.matchingMethod: Manually inspected common cadastral corners; fit a similarity between raster images without shearing. Weak or occluded patches are excluded.

limits: Pixel coordinates are manual observations of a city access study, not construction measurements.
Only the east building supplies the coordinate fit. The other building and numbered OSM entrances are independent checks.
Small fitting residuals do not establish survey accuracy. Allow at least 5 m of plan-position uncertainty; icon centres are less precise.
Do not apply a single translation or stretch the existing station to match this plan.
No elevation, paid-hall width, track spacing or platform length is inferred from these outlines.
The 2012 plan corroborates northern stair identities and public/paid topology; its tenant names and proportions are not current measurements.
